name: contextos
description: Spatial architecture canvas and context optimization OS for AI coding agents with C-D-C-S workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Task-scoped project context and live architecture sync.
interface.longDescription: Read only the project context needed for the current task, then keep blocks, chains, links, code references, progress, and checkpoints synchronized as the implementation changes.
capabilities: OS Markdown documents and chapter retrieval
Persistent task reconciliation and resumable handoffs
Read-only README in the knowledge reader
defaultPrompt: Use ContextOS to understand this task and keep its project graph synchronized.
